en.t: The poem was roughly as follows.

units.source_text: 犒赏使者的是一套女装，又添一件女子常礼服。

en.t: The messenger was rewarded with a complete set of women’s clothing, with one additional formal robe for a lady added as well.

units.source_text: 朱雀院看见紫姬的手笔非常优美，设想幼稚无知的三公主与这位仪态万方、令人羞愧的夫人同列，觉得甚可担忧。

en.t: When Suzaku-in saw how exceptionally beautiful Lady Murasaki’s handwriting was, he imagined the young and inexperienced Third Princess being placed beside this accomplished lady of such graceful bearing, and felt deeply worried.

units.source_text: 此时朱雀院即将入山，女御、更衣等都告别回娘家去，悲哀之事正多。

en.t: At this time Suzaku-in was about to enter the mountains, and the consorts and ladies such as the nyogo and koi were all taking leave and returning to their family homes, so there was much sorrow.

units.source_text: 尚侍胧月夜迁住已故弘徽殿母后的旧居二条宫邸中。

en.t: The Naishi no Kami, Oborozukiyo, moved into the Nijo residence that had formerly belonged to the late Empress Mother of Kokiden.

units.source_text: 除了三公主之事以外，使朱雀院有后顾之忧的，只有这位尚侍。

en.t: Apart from the matter of the Third Princess, the only person who still caused Suzaku-in concern for the future was this Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 尚侍意欲乘朱雀院入山之时削发为尼，但朱雀院劝阻她：“你在此忙乱之时出家，似是故意模仿，态度殊欠郑重。”

en.t: The Naishi no Kami wished to take the tonsure and become a nun when Suzaku-in entered the mountains, but he dissuaded her, saying, “If you take vows at such a confused time, it will look as though you are deliberately imitating me, and the gesture will seem insufficiently solemn.”

units.source_text: 于是暂不出家，逐渐准备修行事宜。

en.t: So for the time being she did not take the tonsure, and gradually began preparing for religious practice.
